## IBD dataset

Gegevensset voor volwassen patiënten met inflammatoire darmziekten (IBD): scopieën en calprotectinemetingen, plus alcoholgebruik.

Version 0.1.0 · definition: [ibd-dataset](Binary-ibd-dataset.html) · generated: [Group](Group-ibd-dataset-cohort.html), [Parameters](Parameters-ibd-dataset-export.html)

---

### Cohort

Alle patiënten van 18 jaar of ouder op het moment van aanleveren met een actief, regulier DBC-zorgtraject
(zorgtype 11 of 21) dat op of na 01-01-2018 is geopend en waarvan de specialisme-diagnose bij IBD hoort.
De startdatum 01-01-2018 is bewust niet dynamisch.

A patient is in the Group when every criterion below is satisfied. Each criterion becomes one bulk-data `member-filter` modifier extension on the Group; the Bulk Data IG defines several filters as all of them having to match.

**Criterion 1: Patient**

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| `birthdate` | `le{today-18y}` |

```text
Patient?birthdate=le{today-18y}
```

**Criterion 2: EpisodeOfCare**

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| `type:in` | `{vs:local-zorgtype-codes}` |
| `status` | `active` |
| `date` | `ge2018-01-01` |
| `diagnosis:Condition.code:in` | `{vs:local-specialisme-diagnose-codes}` |

```text
EpisodeOfCare?type:in=https://ig.santeon.nl/sim-on-fhir/ValueSet/local-zorgtype-codes&status=active&date=ge2018-01-01&diagnosis:Condition.code:in=https://ig.santeon.nl/sim-on-fhir/ValueSet/local-specialisme-diagnose-codes
```

#### K3.6.3 Calprotectine voor scopie

`k363-calprotectin-before-scopie` · version 0.1.0 · definition: [k363-calprotectin-before-scopie](Binary-k363-calprotectin-before-scopie.html)

Percentage scopieën waarbij in de 90 dagen voorafgaand aan de scopie ten minste één fecaal calprotectinemeting is uitgevoerd.

**Criterion 1: Procedure**

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|

Resolved:


**Criterion 2: Observation**

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| `code` | `{od:od-calprotectin.code}` |
| `date` | `ge2018-01-01` |

Resolved:

```text

```

Elements: `code`, `value[x]`, `effective[x]`, `subject`

**Post-query filters**

- A calprotectin measurement counts only when it falls within the 90 days up to and including the start of a scopie of the same patient. A date relation between two resources cannot be expressed in a FHIR search.
  - `Observation.effective >= Procedure.performed.start - 90 days and Observation.effective <= Procedure.performed.start and Observation.subject = Procedure.subject`

### Export request

Resolved from the cohort and the KPI definitions above. Criteria that differ only in their code are rolled up into one filter with a list of codes. `{today}`, `{today-18y}` and `{today-90d}` are replaced by a concrete date and other `{placeholders}` are filled in by the exporter when the request is sent.

**`_type`**

`Procedure,Observation,Patient`

**`_typeFilter`**

```text
Procedure?code:in=https://ig.santeon.nl/sim-on-fhir/ValueSet/local-verrichting-codes-nza&date=ge2018-01-01
Observation?code=http://loinc.org|38445-3,http://snomed.info/sct|228273003&date=ge2018-01-01
Patient?gender=male,female
```

**`_elements`**

```text
Procedure.code,Procedure.performed[x],Procedure.subject,Observation.code,Observation.value[x],Observation.effective[x],Observation.subject,Patient.gender,Patient.birthDate
```

Every `_typeFilter` and every element above must be covered by the de-identification ruleset, see [De-identification](deidentification.html#core-principles).

### Request sequence

The export is a sequence of ordinary FHIR requests, executed in this order by the client. They cannot be combined in one Bundle: `$export` is asynchronous and a transaction cannot wait for a Group that is created asynchronously. Fill in every `{placeholder}` in the Group and the Parameters first.

1. **Create the cohort Group.** `PUT [base]/Group/ibd-dataset-cohort` with the [Group](Group-ibd-dataset-cohort.html). A `PUT` fixes the id, so step 3 does not need to read it from a response. A server that creates the Group asynchronously (Bulk Cohort) answers with a status location; poll it until it is complete.
2. **Wait for the Group.** Continue only when the Group exists and its members are resolved.
3. **Start the export.** `POST [base]/Group/ibd-dataset-cohort/$export` with header `Prefer: respond-async` and the [Parameters](Parameters-ibd-dataset-export.html) as body. The answer is a status location.
4. **Wait for the export.** Poll the status location until it returns the manifest.
5. **Download** the files listed in the manifest.

How the de-identification ruleset reaches the server is not part of the Bulk Data specification and is not decided here.
